blocks.text: Liza Soberano is adding another Hollywood project to her growing résumé as she joins the cast of Audible’s upcoming comedy audio series “The Moons of LA.” Soberano shared Variety’s report about the project on her Instagram Story on Wednesday, Sept. 30. “The Moons of LA” is led by “Community” star Ken Jeong, “Fresh Off the Boat” actor Randall Park and “The Good Doctor” star Daniel Dae Kim. Aside from Soberano, the predominantly Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) cast also includes Jae Suh Park, Alyssa Abiera, Jimmy O. Yang, John Cho, Sherry Cola and Vivian Bang.
